subject: Adding more awesome to build process and documentation
body:
Adding more awesome to build process and documentation

Added global Directory.Build.props and Directory.Build.targets for shared MSBuild settings
Added static code analysers
Added build script that should orchestrate all build and publish logic (easier to test, to setup new pipelines, to understand for new devs)
Fixed .NET version to v6.x so it can work in environments that also have .NET 7 or greater
Cleaned and fixed dependencies in test projects (mRemoteNGTests and mRemoteNGSpecs) so they work again
Organized project into logical folders in solution: Application, Tests, Documentation, Installer, _Misc for quick navigation and access to config and build files (available in _Misc)
Moved Add-ons/README.md to documentation + some updates to be able to run sphinx locally (in Visual Studio Code)
Added a skeleton project for generating documentation when it's build. It tries to use system python if installed, else it will install python locally from NuGet along with required sphynx module
Moved all documentation files into mRemoteNG/source file, to match official sphynx folder structure and also separate the docs .csproj and its build artifacts from the documentation itself
Added vswhere and nuget executables as build process helpers
